releaseNotes: 🚀 Official Production Release (V1.0.6 - Build 69)
✨ Player Queue Gesture: Removed visible 'Q' button; queue is now seamlessly revealed via an intuitive swipe-up gesture on the player with smooth Compose transitions.
⬇️ Real-Time Download Notification: Native Android notification progress bar displays live download percentage and automatically clears upon completion, cancellation, or failure.
📺 Android TV & Google TV Universal Support: Full Leanback launcher banner and touch-free remote control compatibility on Android TV, Google TV, and Fire TV devices.
🎮 TV Remote Media Keys: Native hardware remote Play/Pause, Next, Previous, Fast-Forward, and Rewind media key responsiveness.
📋 Smart Queue Management & Home Tab Reset: Universal long-press song context menu (Play Next, Add to Queue) and deterministic Home tab reset without playback interruption.

releaseNotes: 🚀 Official Windows Desktop Production Release (V1.0.4 - Build 67)
🛡️ Hardened Windows Release Pipeline & Inno Setup Packaging with AppUserModelID identity integration
📦 Added Zero-Install Standalone Portable Package (LofiQ-v1.0.4-Windows-Portable.zip) with MotW unblock instructions
🎵 True Dual-Player Gapless & Equal-Power Crossfade Architecture via media_kit & libmpv
⚡ Early ~10s Silent Preloading with readiness verification and bounded demuxer readahead
♾️ Zero-Overlap Gapless Playback (0s) with EOF race fix and smooth pause/resume mid-transition
🎛️ 10-Band Graphic Equalizer, Bass Boost & Spatial Virtualizer synchronized across both slots
⌨️ Windows System Media Transport Controls (SMTC), Hardware Media Keys & LRCLIB Lyrics
